values.declaration_clause: At any time during the game, the kicking team may declare an onside kick
values.declaration: the kicking team must declare the onside kick to the Referee; no surprise onside kick

regime_rows.element: May an onside kick be attempted at any time?
regime_rows.verbatim: At any time during the game, the kicking team may declare an onside kick

regime_rows.element: Must it be declared to the Referee?
regime_rows.verbatim: may declare an onside kick by notifying the Referee prior to the start of the play clock

regime_rows.element: Can it ever be a surprise onside kick?
regime_rows.verbatim: The Referee will then notify the receiving team before starting the play clock
(25-second play clock after the game official hands the kicker the ball)
the restraining line for a kickoff
The restraining line for the kicking team on an onside kick is the kicking team's 35-yard line
or the kicking team's 20-yard line for a safety kick
the "setup zone" for the receiving team is the 5-yard area
between the receiving team's 35-yard line and its 30-yard line

regime_rows.element: Touchback after a kickoff from the 50
regime_rows.verbatim: if the kickoff is from the 50-yard line and the play results in a touchback, then the dead ball spot is the 20-yard line

model_notes.pre_2026_assumption: an onside kick is only available to a trailing team late in the game
model_notes.2026_rule: any team, at any time, by declaration
model_notes.bias_if_ignored: the model understates a leading team's option value and mis-states the available state space for the trailing team's comeback path
model_notes.priced_here: not priced — the availability change is stated, the frequency is not held

model_notes.pre_2026_assumption: an onside kick can be a surprise play
model_notes.2026_rule: declaration to the Referee is mandatory; the receiving team is notified
model_notes.bias_if_ignored: a surprise-recovery rate from any earlier season is not transferable, because the defence is told to expect the kick
model_notes.priced_here: not priced — no official play-by-play capture is held

model_notes.affects: drive-start distributions after a kickoff penalty
model_notes.pre_2026_assumption: a kickoff from the 50 is an ordinary kickoff
model_notes.2026_rule: a touchback from the 50 puts the ball at the 20
model_notes.bias_if_ignored: field-position priors after a 15-yard kickoff penalty are wrong in one direction
model_notes.priced_here: not priced — field-position priors are not modelled

model_notes.pre_2026_assumption: the setup zone is a single 5-yard band with a fixed 9-player rule
model_notes.2026_rule: alignment requirements in the setup zone changed for 2026 (6-1-3)
model_notes.bias_if_ignored: return-yardage priors trained on 2024-2025 alignments do not transfer
model_notes.priced_here: not priced — no return-yardage capture is held

what_is_still_open: How often clubs declared an onside kick in 2026, and how often a declared onside kick was recovered, are empirical frequencies. This project holds no official play-by-play capture, so both stay blank and are published as blank rather than estimated.
